text:
sarah_sales: quick sync — FinBank (EU) POC just flagged a couple blockers: they need a certified sub-processor inventory for each eu region, a clear statement that all inference and embeddings remain inside EU regions, and confirmation on tenant pinning vs tenant peering. looping in @jordan_se and @ashley_eng to confirm technical feasibility.

jordan_se: thanks — are they asking for per-region SOC/ISO certs or just validated cloud provider names?

sarah_sales: they specifically requested a list with cert badges (SOC2/ISO27001) per subproc and whether we serve data from that region or cross-region egress is possible. also worried about KMS loc — they want keys not to leave EU.

ashley_eng: we can supply a subproc list for eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. our hosted control-plane is global but customer data path can be pinned to EU regions for inference. KMS: we support customer-managed keys in EU via partner KMS; need to confirm HSM SLA.

mike_research: FYI model variants: some quantized variants are only hosted in us-east due to GPU availability today. we can deploy eu-quantized nodes for the POC but that adds ~20% infra premium.

sarah_sales: pricing question came up — they want to understand delta for region-isolated dedicated pools vs hosted eu-only capacity. @ashley_eng any quick numbers?

ashley_eng: rough: hosted multi-region baseline. eu-only dedicated + reserved capacity adds ~monthly base + ~25% per-token cost uplift (GPU premium + fewer pooling savings). can give precise with sizing.

jordan_se: on routing — we support three patterns: tenant_pin (customer pinned to a region/pool), geofence (route by IP/region), and failover (primary eu fallback to eu-secondary). Customer asked about tenant peering (VPC peering) + tenant_pin. that's supported for Dedicated; for Hosted we have tenant-virtual-network to isolate traffic but not full L2 peering.

legal_ops: can we confirm sub-processor cert artifacts? they want contact point and date of last audit.

ashley_eng: we'll provide the subproc inventory csv and latest cert links. sample routing config for POC we can propose:

```
routing_policy:
  mode: tenant_pin
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  fallback_regions: [eu-central-1]
  enforce_kms_region: eu-west-1
  allow_cross_region_egress: false
```

jordan_se: one more ops detail — if tenant_pin is enabled on Hosted, autoscaling can still burst to other EU zones under same region, but not to non-EU. For Dedicated we can guarantee physical isolation to customer pool.

sarah_sales: next steps for POC: 1) provide subproc cert inventory + contact links 2) provide eu-only routing config and estimate delta pricing 3) confirm KMS HSM/region isolation options & SLA 4) run short infra cost estimate for deploying eu-quantized model variant. I'll tell the customer we'll need ~48–72 hours to produce docs.

mike_research: to get eu-quantized nodes spun up we'll need model build + validation — estimate 3 workdays for one variant (can accelerate with infra priority at cost).

ashley_eng: I'll prepare the inventory and a one-page POC routing spec. pinging infra-bot to attach latest sub-processor manifest.

infra-bot: attached: https://internal.redwood/examples/subproc-manifest-eu-2026-03-20.pdf (internal link) :white_check_mark:

legal_ops: I'll prepare the cert summary and the contact point for audits.

sarah_sales: perfect — thanks team. I'll reply to FinBank with the timeline. will follow up here with any customer pushback. :thumbsup:
